// Throwaway: run inside a historical checkout to produce a genuine export
// written by that version's own code. Not part of the repo.
import 'dart:io';

import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:ironyx/core/database/app_database.dart';
import 'package:ironyx/core/services/data_export_service.dart';

void main() {
  test('generate fixture', () async {
    final db = AppDatabase.forTesting();
    final firstIds = <String, String>{};

    Future<void> insertRow(String table, {Map<String, Object?> overrides = const {}}) async {
      final cols = await db.customSelect('PRAGMA table_info("$table")').get();
      final fks = await db.customSelect('PRAGMA foreign_key_list("$table")').get();
      final fkParent = {for (final f in fks) f.read<String>('from'): f.read<String>('table')};
      final row = <String, Object?>{};
      for (final c in cols) {
        final name = c.read<String>('name');
        final type = c.read<String>('type').toUpperCase();
        final pk = c.read<int>('pk') > 0;
        if (fkParent.containsKey(name)) {
          row[name] = firstIds[fkParent[name]!];
        } else if (pk && type == 'TEXT') {
          row[name] = '${table.replaceAll('_table', '')}_1';
        } else if (type == 'INTEGER') {
          row[name] = name.startsWith('is_') ? 0
              : (name.endsWith('_at') || name == 'date') ? 1754006400 : 1;
        } else if (type == 'REAL') {
          row[name] = 42.5;
        } else if (type == 'TEXT') {
          row[name] = 'x';
        }
      }
      row.addAll(overrides);
      // Where the explicit marker exists (v8+), the app itself sets it on a
      // custom exercise.
      if (row.containsKey('is_custom') && row['seed_version'] == 0) {
        row['is_custom'] = 1;
      }
      final names = row.keys.toList();
      await db.customStatement(
        'INSERT INTO "$table" (${names.map((n) => '"$n"').join(', ')}) '
        'VALUES (${List.filled(names.length, '?').join(', ')})',
        [for (final n in names) row[n]],
      );
      final pkCol = cols.where((c) => c.read<int>('pk') > 0).firstOrNull;
      if (pkCol != null) {
        firstIds.putIfAbsent(table, () => row[pkCol.read<String>('name')]! as String);
      }
    }

    await db.customStatement('PRAGMA foreign_keys = OFF');
    for (final t in db.allTables) {
      await insertRow(t.actualTableName);
    }
    // A custom exercise under the pre-v8 convention (seed_version == 0),
    // logged in a workout.
    await insertRow('exercises_table', overrides: {'id': 'ex_custom', 'slug': 'custom-lift', 'name': 'My Custom Lift', 'seed_version': 0});
    await insertRow('workout_exercises_table', overrides: {'id': 'workout_exercises_2', 'exercise_id': 'ex_custom', 'order_index': 1});
    await db.customStatement('PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON');
    final bad = await db.customSelect('PRAGMA foreign_key_check').get();
    expect(bad, isEmpty);

    final json = await const DataExportService().buildJsonExport(db);
    File(Platform.environment['FIXTURE_OUT']!).writeAsStringSync(json);
    await db.close();
  });
}
